meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary
meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Тебе ещё не надоела серая Москва?
examples.trans: Are you not tired of gray Moscow yet?

examples.text: Нам сейчас срочно надо идти на улицу.
examples.trans: We urgently need to go outside right now.

examples.text: Надо срочно бежать к Элеоноре!
examples.trans: I must urgently run to Eleonora!

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'рочно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Нам сейчас срочно надо идти на улицу.
examples.trans: We urgently need to go outside right now.

examples.text: Надо срочно бежать к Элеоноре!
examples.trans: I must urgently run to Eleonora!

examples.text: Надо срочно спасать наш ресторан!
examples.trans: We must urgently save our restaurant!

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to run, flee', paired with 'побежать'.

examples.text: Надо срочно бежать к Элеоноре!
examples.trans: I must urgently run to Eleonora!

examples.text: Беги, Марина, пока не поздно!
examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!

examples.text: Куда ты так быстро бежишь?
examples.trans: Where are you running so fast?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'to, towards', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Тебе ещё не надоела серая Москва?
examples.trans: Are you not tired of gray Moscow yet?

examples.text: А ты случайно не слишком торопишься?
examples.trans: Are you not rushing things a bit too much?

examples.text: По-моему, я уже жутко опаздываю.
examples.trans: In my opinion, I am already terribly late.
